name.value: Best Western Plus Columbia River Hotel

description.value: The Best Western Plus Columbia River Hotel is an award-winning boutique hotel in Trail's business district overlooking the Columbia River. The property offers premium rooms and is positioned as a refined, full-service stay in one of the Kootenays' most industrial yet scenically striking small cities. Trail serves as a gateway to mountain biking, skiing, and rail-trail cycling in the surrounding region.

address.value: 1001 Rossland Avenue, Trail, British Columbia V1R 3N7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is an active Best Western booking page confirming the property at 1001 Rossland Avenue, Trail, BC, with address matching OSM. The website URL parameters include 'free-breakfast' and 'free-high-speed-internet', providing evidence for those amenities; OSM also tags internet_access=wlan corroborating Wi-Fi. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike storage, laundry, tools, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the fetched content, so those remain null. A notable concern is the OSM official_name field listing 'Aiden by Best Western' while the OSM name and website both show 'Best Western Plus Columbia River Hotel', suggesting a possible rebrand or data error.
concerns: OSM official_name field is 'Aiden by Best Western', which differs from both the OSM name field and the website branding ('Best Western Plus Columbia River Hotel'). This may indicate a rebrand in progress, a stale OSM edit, or a data error — worth verifying against the property directly.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly bookable hotel in Trail, BC with an active website and confirmed address. Useful to touring cyclists passing through the Kootenays.
